title: Choose Tidewell's visual world
question: The roll assigned the bedtime picture-book room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Night-Feed Picture Book
options.lineage: American bedtime picture books: flat gouache rooms, a window, the moon
options.thesis: Tidewell as the picture book you are awake inside at 3 a.m.: one quiet room, and the moon that pulls the tide.
options.viewport: A room-green wall with a night window; the voice button is the moon rising over a tide line; the headline and Start tonight sit on the wall like a page of the book.
options.risk: Can turn childish if the lettering goes cute; must evoke the picture-book tradition, never copy any book's art.

raised.raise: Status in sentences, not badges: 'Your blood pressure has been above 140/90', never four 'Visit soon' pills.
Plain literal labels: every place named for what it is (Check in, Your tide, Visits), no product jargon like 'Watch agent'.
One mark used everywhere: the moon over a tide line, in the nav, on the voice button and the favicon.
Type scale tied to urgency: the more it matters, the bigger and plainer it is set.
Every state addressable with an obvious way back.

options.label: The Receiving Blanket
options.lineage: the striped hospital swaddle blanket every new parent is handed
options.thesis: The first thing that held your baby: white flannel with the familiar pink and blue stripes, now holding you.
options.viewport: A wide flannel field; three stripe bands frame the headline and become the tide chart bands below.
options.risk: Familiar baby-pastel territory, and pink/blue carry gender connotations the brand would need to neutralise.

options.label: Blue-Hour Window
options.lineage: the city at night seen from a nursery window
options.thesis: 3 a.m. through the window: cobalt sky, amber streetlights, and a silver dawn line that means the night is ending.
options.viewport: A skyline band under a cobalt sky; check-in time sets the hour of the scene; dawn silver marks a good night.
options.case: Holds the 3 a.m. audience scene well, loses on clarity: a city says nothing about recovery after birth.
options.risk: Urban-only imagery, and a dark scene by day feels wrong.

options.label: Stockroom Quote Labels
options.thesis: Every zone named in straight quotes over hazard stripes.
options.viewport: Quoted caps labels on white cotton.
options.risk: Hazard stripes read as alarm to an exhausted parent.
options.case: Loses both axes: hype and hazard are wrong for postpartum care.
options.kept: Literal labels: every place named plainly for what it is.

options.label: Earthy Woodcut Identity
options.thesis: A stamped woodcut sun over torn kraft paper.
options.viewport: A woodcut mark centred over torn-paper sections.
options.case: Loses both axes: nostalgic retail, not a health companion.
options.kept: One stamped mark used consistently everywhere.

options.label: Variety-Show Captions
options.thesis: Captions sized to the emotion of speech.
options.viewport: Free-placed outlined captions over the frame.
options.case: Loses both axes: too loud for a tired, worried reader.
options.kept: Scale mapped to intensity: urgency sets the type size.

options.label: HyperCard Stack
options.thesis: Black-and-white cards linked by painted buttons.
options.viewport: A fixed card with painted buttons.
options.case: Loses both axes: one-bit retro says nothing about care.
options.kept: Every state addressable, with an obvious way back.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: A breathing cursor and a scrolling transcript.
options.viewport: One continuous transcript on dark glass.
options.risk: Cold, technical, and unreadable for many.
options.case: Loses both axes: a machine room is the opposite of reassurance.
options.kept: System states print themselves as sentences rather than chrome.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A calm wellness app: soft teal, rounded white cards, friendly sans, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and a phone mockup side by side, feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other wellness app by design.
